sections.shortTitle: Judges Leave Pension And Privileges Amendment Order 1988
sections.section: ORDER - Judges (Leave  Pension And Privileges) (Amendment) Order 1988
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 5 OF 1988
JUDGES (LEAVE,
PENSION AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ORDER,
1988
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 5
OF 1988
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 29th hay, 1988]
No.F.17(1)/88-Pub., dated
29-5-1988.-----The following Order made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1968
(P.O. No.1 of 19688), and the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges)
Order, 1970 (P.O.No.9 of 1970), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by the Fifth Schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make the following Order:--
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Order may be called the Judges (Leave, Pension
and Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 1988.
(2) It shall core into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect, on the first day of July, 1987.
2. Amendment of P.O.No.1 of
1968.--In the Supreme Court Judges, (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order,
1968 (P.O. No.1 of 1968), after paragraph 16-A, the following new paragraph
shall be inserted, namely:--
"16-B. Cost
of living allowance in addition to pension.--A cost of living allowance at
the monthly rate specified below shall be paid to a Judge who retires on or
after the first day of July, 1987, and is entitled to a pension under this
Order so, however, that the aggregate amount of such allowance and such pension
does not exceed the maximum amount so specified:--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Judge Rate Maximum
Amount
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Chief Justice Rs.2,340.00
Rs.8,000.00
Other Judge Rs
2,100.00 Rs.7,125.00"
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. Amendment of. P.O. No. 9 of
1970.--In the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1970
(P.O. No.9 of 1970), after paragraph 16-A, the following new paragraph shall be
inserted, namely:--
"16-8. Cost
of living allowance in addition to pension.----A cost of living allowance
at the monthly rate specified below shall be paid to a Judge. who retires on or
after. the first day of July, 1987, and is entitled to a pension under this
Order so, however, that the aggregate amount of such allowance and such pension
does not exceed the maximum amount so specified:--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Judge Rate Maximum
Amount
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Chief Justice Rs.3,340.00
Rs.7,050.00
Other Judge Rs
2,640.00 Rs.6,300.00"
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. Cost of living allowance
to cease to be admissible on revision of pension of Judges.--The cost of
living allowance provided for in this Order shall cease to be admissible on the
which an amendment of the Fifth Schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan to revise the pensions payable to the Judges of the
Supreme Court and the High Courts comes into force.
